channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [repo] gitcommit90/1Helm
item.description: Personal AI workspace deployed on Cloudflare that provides persistent memory, channel computers, and support for user-supplied AI providers.

item.title: [news] Edge0-145B: Frontier AI Capabilities on Your Own Computer
item.description: Edge0-145B is an open-source 145-billion-parameter on-device AI model that brings coding, reasoning, and agent capabilities to personal computers without cloud-model token fees.

item.title: [news] llm-gemini 0.37
item.description: Release: llm-gemini 0.37 Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen today - the lowest cost member of the Gemini 4 family. It's actually not too far off the price of its much bigger siblings, Carbon and Argon. I'm finding Gemini 4's pricing really confusing.

item.title: [news] Deploy frontier AI models on AWS Trainium with SGLang-Neuron
item.description: SGLang-Neuron is an AWS Deep Learning Container that enables users to serve frontier AI models and generate reinforcement learning rollouts on AWS Trainium using PyTorch.

item.title: [news] Chinese frontier AI models carry the fingerprint of export-controlled GPUs
item.description: A forensic analysis of publicly released AI models finds evidence that several Chinese AI developers are using export-controlled NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs to create their models.

item.title: [news] How Natera designed an agentic AI system for lab ops with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: SWARM is an agentic AI system built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that captures and scales institutional knowledge for lab operations.

item.title: [news] Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #98
item.description: What's new in research at Microsoft? Host Anson Ho explores the latest, including AI-powered universal translation, a breakthrough in a 31-year-old mathematics challenge, and advances making AI coding agents faster and more efficient.

item.title: [news] AI is turning Apple's app review process into a nightmare for synth developers
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from synthanatomy.com. 152 points and 146 comments.

item.title: [news] Four Amazon Bedrock inference choices that affect cost
item.description: Your Amazon Bedrock inference bill can keep climbing even after you tune prompts and application logic. Four request-level choices (cache duration, service tier, reasoning effort, and maxTokens) change how many tokens the service processes and the rate applied.

item.title: [news] Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility
item.description: Representatives from Nvidia told Illinois representative Bill Foster that it would be technically possible to implement the anti-smuggling measures called for in the Chip Security Act, Foster told MIT Technology Review in an interview on Thursday, even while an industry group…

item.title: [news] How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
item.description: Amplitude uses OpenAI models to power Wave, a proactive product agent that identifies features, assists teams with coding agents, and measures impact.

item.title: [repo] zovulrira1974/blender-ai-copilot-assets
item.description: Asset-savvy AI copilot for Blender that allows users to search external libraries, check licenses, and import assets into scenes through a supervised conversation.

item.title: [repo] tiobeharxi1987/blender-ai-copilot-flow
item.description: Controlled AI workflow for Blender that requires user approval for every copilot edit and provides sequential execution and named undo steps.

item.title: [repo] fumbdendade19718/blender-ai-copilot-desk
item.description: Blender AI Copilot Desk is a visual AI companion window for Blender that combines chat, scene objects, viewport snapshots, approvals, and a task board.

item.title: [repo] benzgasfuncring197110/blender-ai-copilot-bridge
item.description: Model Context Protocol bridge for Blender that exposes supervised scene tools to compatible clients via an authenticated local HTTP endpoint.

item.title: [repo] precygtrucqui1981/blender-ai-copilot-lab
item.description: Blender AI Copilot Lab is an AI lab for Blender that uses manager, worker, and reviewer agent teams to run multi-step scene briefs as supervised experiments.

item.title: [repo] baiblinocun1986/blender-ai-copilot-hub
item.description: Blender AI Copilot Hub is a multi-provider AI copilot hub for Blender that integrates various AI model connections and supervised scene tools into a single interface.

item.title: [repo] credoksopho1984/blender-ai-copilot-studio
item.description: AI copilot and Model Context Protocol server for Blender that converts plain-language briefs into multi-step scene operations using built-in scene tools.

item.title: [repo] racdeufindurch198812/Blender-AI-MCP-Studio
item.description: Blender AI MCP Studio is an AI assistant and Model Context Protocol server for Blender that turns plain-language briefs into inspected, approved, and reversible 3D scene operations.

item.title: [repo] findavoulot1973/Blender-AI-MCP-Suite
item.description: Blender assistant and Model Context Protocol server that translates plain-language briefs into supervised, reversible 3D scene operations with a visual studio workspace.

item.title: [paper] Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
item.description: PixVid is a method that adapts a pretrained latent video model to generate every frame directly in pixel space, improving resolution, responsiveness, and video editing quality.

item.title: [paper] Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
item.description: A controlled study on multimodal vision encoding finds that a jointly trained vision encoder from scratch matches pretrained encoders, and that dedicated vision capacity is essential for visual understanding.

item.title: [paper] TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
item.description: Test-Time Baking is a strategy that learns to bake global scene information into a lightweight MLP to enable fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding for decoder-only view synthesis models.

item.title: [paper] ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
item.description: ArchSpace is a public platform for recording, reviewing, and referencing large language model architecture research that uses scaling laws to predict model performance from smaller experiments.

item.title: [paper] ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation
item.description: ProtoVis-Nav is a visual imagination framework for unmanned aerial vehicles that predicts feature prototypes to align visual context with waypoint outputs for improved navigation.

item.title: [paper] Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
item.description: A neurosymbolic reinforcement learning approach for portfolio allocation uses Monte Carlo sampling to estimate policy compliance with investment mandates and significantly reduces rule violations.

item.title: [paper] K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
item.description: K2V is a generative keyframing method that uses a language model to handle physical reasoning and condition a video generation model to produce physically plausible videos.

item.title: [paper] AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
item.description: AgentSSL is a semi-supervised learning framework that frames pipeline design as a program search problem, allowing machine learning agents to leverage unlabeled data and surpass human-engineered baselines.

item.title: [paper] BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
item.description: BrickFlow is a connectivity-guided brick reconstruction method that uses an SE(3) flow model and analytic connectivity-field guidance to infer the poses of LEGO parts from an image.

item.title: [paper] Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
item.description: DiVR is a verifier for diffusion language models that predicts whether a generated sequence will reach a correct answer to determine when and what text to regenerate.

item.title: [paper] Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
item.description: Spatial Foundry is a multimodal dataset of 5,280 furnished 3D scene configurations with aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data, useful for spatial intelligence and 3D generation research.

item.title: [paper] CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
item.description: CoReMem is a cost-internalizing memory framework for coding agents that uses prospective segment valuation to improve task resolution rates while reducing steps and token usage.

item.title: [paper] Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
item.description: Research on meta-learned neural networks demonstrates that their parameter vectors exhibit additive compositional relationships that allow them to implement new functions without direct training.

item.title: [paper] Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
item.description: A new sketching algorithm for language model context attribution estimates leave-one-out values efficiently by applying forward differentiation to the backpropagation circuit.

item.title: [paper] Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
item.description: CRAM is a learned energy-based model that solves reasoning puzzles significantly faster and with fewer FLOPs than baseline looped models.

item.title: [paper] Quantifying structural stability of transparent models for general insurance pricing
item.description: A proposed mean squared shape function distance metric quantifies the structural stability of functionally transparent machine learning models for insurance pricing.

item.title: [paper] Towards a Theory of Learnability via Debate
item.description: An online learning formulation of debate as a training protocol characterizes the learnability of complex functions using a combinatorial dimension.

item.title: [paper] FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
item.description: FLEX-LBP learns local binary pattern parameters via backpropagation to improve texture classification accuracy while maintaining interpretable hard-binary inference.

item.title: [paper] Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
item.description: Vid2vid-long is a correspondence-based video translation approach that uses patch-level input correspondences to maintain long-range temporal consistency in real-time generation.

item.title: [paper] Goal Encoding in LLMs
item.description: Research into goal encoding in large language models localizes causal sub-goal representations in sparse attention heads and proposes a non-recurrent goal-seeking account for action execution.

item.title: [paper] Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
item.description: Metal Sandbox is an open-source infrastructure for Apple Silicon that combines file access, command execution, and scheduling to improve GPU coding agent throughput.

item.title: [paper] Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
item.description: Negative-Only Policy Optimization is a reinforcement learning method that improves performance on code, logic, and math tasks by updating policies using only verified negative examples.

item.title: [news] Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator
item.description: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen inside Google Antigravity alongside an Orchestrator model option to balance quality, efficiency, and latency on long-horizon tasks.

item.title: [paper] Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
item.description: Synthesis Smuggling is a threat model where an adversarial large language model infers sensitive user attributes from conversations and steganographically encodes them into generated content.

item.title: [paper] LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
item.description: LiveGeo is a benchmark and platform that evaluates the ability of large language models to make reliable decisions in continuously evolving geographic environments.

item.title: [paper] Programming Quantum Circuit Parameters with Large Language Models
item.description: Research into programming quantum circuit parameters using large language models finds that physical structure helps generate low-energy configurations, while iterative optimization provides limited benefit.

item.title: [paper] Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
item.description: Ballad is an online bandit algorithm that orchestrates an ensemble of large language models for automated heuristic discovery by learning to route tasks across models.

item.title: [paper] Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention
item.description: Analysis of Vision Transformer attention reveals that instance separation is driven by query-key relations that direct patches of the same object to shared attention addresses.

item.title: [paper] When Both Sides Adapt: The Challenges of Evaluating Interactive LLM Systems
item.description: Study of interactive large language model systems reveals that user adaptivity causes offline benchmarks and live experiments to rank models differently.

item.title: [paper] Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models
item.description: Al-Ghasali is a computational framework that combines deterministic finite state automata with large language models to simulate Islamic jurisprudential rulings while preventing hallucinations.

item.title: [paper] Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation
item.description: Mathematical analysis of knowledge distillation reveals that its primary benefit is faster optimization speed rather than improved generalization for student models.

item.title: [paper] Linear Regression with Self-Selection Bias in Polynomial Time
item.description: We revisit the problem of estimating $k$ linear regressors with self-selection bias in $n$ dimensions up to error $\varepsilon$ with the maximum self-selection criterion, as introduced by Cherapanamjeri, Daskalakis, Ilyas, and Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC].

item.title: [paper] Sheaf-Inspired Structured Scoring Extensions of LightGCN for Collaborative Filtering
item.description: Graph-based collaborative filtering learns user and item representations by propagating embeddings over a user--item interaction graph. We investigate a modular, sheaf-inspired scoring extension placed on top of a three-layer LightGCN backbone.

item.title: [paper] Data Archive for 2D and 3D Electrical Impedance Tomography with moderate conductivity contrast phantoms
item.description: This document describes open Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) measurement data that were collected from biomedical imaging inspired phantoms with moderate conductivity contrasts.

item.title: [paper] Combinatorial Bernoulli Factories with Polynomially Many Coins
item.description: We provide an efficient implementation of combinatorial Bernoulli factories. Such a factory turns coins of unknown biases $x$ into a random vertex of a polytope $P$ whose mean is exactly $x$.

item.title: [paper] Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline
item.description: Oral exams are compelling because (1) students can be asked to provide their reasoning for an answer and (2) their interactive nature permits follow-up questions to resolve ambiguous answers. But oral exams scale poorly.

item.title: [paper] Introducing Feedback Delays to Non-Delayed Adversarial MDPs: Optimal $\sqrt S$ and $\sqrt K$ Dependencies in Tabular and Linear AMDPs
item.description: We study regret minimization in episodic Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (AMDPs) with unknown transitions and bandit feedback.

item.title: [paper] Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Sparse Convolution
item.description: Deep neural networks for image processing are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained edge devices such as drones, medical systems, and smartphones, where limited computational resources and memory bandwidth pose significant challenges for efficient inference.

item.title: [paper] MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI
item.description: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information.

item.title: [paper] Physically Interpretable Basin Selection in Discrete-Variable Origami Design
item.description: Automatic differentiation has enabled rapid progress on continuous-variable mechanical design problems, but gradient-based optimization still struggles with discrete variables.

item.title: [paper] eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
item.description: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the…

item.title: [paper] Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
item.description: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings.

item.title: [paper] Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
item.description: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves.

item.title: [paper] Cortex-FL: Agent-Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning
item.description: Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data.

item.title: [paper] Neural Render Proxies for Interactive and Differentiable Lighting
item.description: Within the CG animation production pipeline, the challenges artists tackle in Lighting can be immense.

item.title: [tool] Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
item.description: Hey HN! We're Alireza and Majid building Leeroo ( https://leeroo.com/ ). Previously we’ve built AI systems for products with millions of users, including at LinkedIn and Meta. We’re now focusing on building AI systems for enterprise data.

item.title: [paper] Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
item.description: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph.

item.title: [paper] SpotDiff: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Zero-Shot Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
item.description: Remote sensing change detection usually relies on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations, which limits its scalability across regions, imaging platforms and application domains.

item.title: [paper] Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
item.description: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens.

item.title: [paper] Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
item.description: A decision model that acts poorly can still teach reinforcement learning policies effectively by judging complete action trajectories, improving success on ALFWorld and WebShop.

item.title: [paper] UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
item.description: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored.

item.title: [paper] Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
item.description: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers.

item.title: [paper] Cited but Unused: Parametric Provenance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: Retrieval-augmented generation systems attach citations to attribute claims to their sources. These citations frequently misstate provenance, and standard verification cannot detect this.

item.title: [paper] AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
item.description: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on datasets that each vary one design family in one flow domain.

item.title: [paper] HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment
item.description: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge.

item.title: [paper] Enhancing Preference Detection using Eye Movement Cascade and Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
item.description: Understanding how visual attention influences human preference formation is a fundamental problem in consumer behavior and cognitive science. In this work, we investigate how eye movement patterns can be used to predict preference decisions when subjects compare two alternatives.

item.title: [paper] A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
item.description: We study data poisoning attacks on logistic regression with $\ell_2$-regularization, where an attacker chooses the features of a fixed number of injected observations with prescribed labels to maximize the logistic loss on the clean training data.

item.title: [paper] ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs
item.description: A foundational principle of physics is that all coordinate systems are equally valid: the behavior of a PDE-governed system does not depend on the origin or orientation of the frame, nor on the units or mesh used to write it down, and neither should a surrogate model.

item.title: [paper] Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data
item.description: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury.

item.title: [paper] Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
item.description: Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol.

item.title: [paper] Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
item.description: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware.

item.title: [paper] STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
item.description: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission.

item.title: [paper] Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
item.description: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit.

item.title: [paper] Bellman Contraction under MMD: A Unified Framework
item.description: We introduce a mathematical framework for studying contraction of the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD).

item.title: [paper] CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
item.description: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces.

item.title: [paper] Designing Institutions for Autonomous AI
item.description: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact in persistent populations, their collective capabilities and alignment depend not only on individual models, but also on the institutions governing their interactions. Yet AI research has largely focused on individual agents.

item.title: [paper] Spatiotemporal learning improves quantification of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement
item.description: Pore-space evolution and fluid displacement influence how rocks transmit and store fluids, affecting geological carbon storage, underground hydrogen storage and groundwater contaminant transport.

item.title: [paper] SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
item.description: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision.

item.title: [paper] Near-Optimal Regret for Oracle-Efficient Adversarial Contextual Bandits
item.description: We study contextual bandits with $K$ actions, a class of $N$ policies, and i.i.d.\ contexts from a distribution that the learner can sample.

item.title: [paper] LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
item.description: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super.

item.title: [paper] Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
item.description: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.

item.title: [paper] Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
item.description: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology.

item.title: [paper] TuMAP: A Dual-View, Morphotype-Aware Pathomics Pipeline for Quantifying Renal Tubular Remodeling
item.description: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous.

item.title: [paper] Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging
item.description: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps.

item.title: [paper] A Compact xDAWN-Guided Spatio-Temporal Network with Filter-Bank Convolution for P300 Detection
item.description: P300-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) enable communication by decoding stimulus-evoked EEG responses into character selections without requiring voluntary motor output.

item.title: [paper] Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States
item.description: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving demand for new data centers at large scale and on short deployment timelines.

item.title: [paper] Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography
item.description: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction.

item.title: [paper] SALT: State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer for Single-Temporal Cross-Dataset Structural Localization in Remote Sensing
item.description: Change detection in remote sensing conventionally relies on spatially aligned bi-temporal imagery, which may be unavailable or unreliable in practical scenarios.

item.title: [paper] Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
item.description: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls.

item.title: [paper] Evaluation of Music Version Retrieval Methods for Setlist Identification in Live Concerts
item.description: Automatic setlist identification aims to identify the songs performed in live concert recordings by matching noisy and variable-quality audio against a database of reference tracks.

item.title: [paper] Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
item.description: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness.

item.title: [paper] An Invariant Neural-Network Eddy-Viscosity Closure with Iterative Solver Coupling for Molten Salt Fast Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
item.description: System thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) close turbulence on coarse meshes with algebraic zero-equation mixing-length models.

item.title: [paper] Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
item.description: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments.

item.title: [paper] Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
item.description: Online conformal risk control (OCRC) enables reliable uncertainty quantification in machine learning by converting model outputs into prediction sets with long-term risk guarantees.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
item.description: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event.

item.title: [paper] Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
item.description: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited.

item.title: [paper] AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video
item.description: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation.

item.title: [paper] Infrastructure for Verifiable AI: Where Proof Costs Go and How Hardware Can Help
item.description: Users of artificial intelligence services, including those powered by large language models and other transformer-based models, need assurance that inference and training follow the declared computation without exposing private models or data.

item.title: [paper] From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research
item.description: Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent's context.

item.title: [paper] Prevalence Bounds for Edited Watermarked Text: Power Envelopes and Calibration Sensitivity
item.description: Watermark detectors decide whether one document came from a watermarked language model. Auditors often need a different number: the share of a corpus that did.

item.title: [paper] Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
item.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data.

item.title: [paper] Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models
item.description: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics.

item.title: [paper] Temporal Regularized Learning: Self-Supervised Learning Local in Space and Time
item.description: Layer-local self-supervised objectives remove the backward pass between layers, but almost all still compute their loss over a batch of samples and are therefore local in space but not in time.

item.title: [paper] AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations.

item.title: [paper] Anonymous in Name Only: A Critical Review and a Reidentification Exercise on the European Commission's Anonymization Measures for Google Search Data under Article 6(11) of the DMA
item.description: In July 2026, the European Commission (EC) set out the anonymization measures Alphabet must implement to share Google Search data with competing search engines under Article 6(11) of the Digital Markets Act.

item.title: [paper] Random Exploration is Random
item.description: Decision making often requires balancing exploitation of familiar options with exploration of uncertain alternatives. One strategy for exploration is random exploration, in which choices become more variable and less tied to the option that currently appears best.

item.title: [paper] Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
item.description: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users.

item.title: [paper] An Integrated Architecture for Data-Efficient Real-Time Neural Imitation of Nonlinear Time-Optimal Model Predictive Control
item.description: Nonlinear time-optimal model predictive control (TOMPC) enables highly performant control of constrained systems, but its computational cost prohibits real-time use on fast dynamical systems.

item.title: [paper] Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
item.description: We develop score-based generative models for time series and standard finite-dimensional data, building on the analytical computation of the expected signature of a new class of jump-diffusions, called entire sig-jump-diffusions.

item.title: [paper] AnalogLayoutWorld: An Open Benchmark for Agentic Analog Layout Design
item.description: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood.

item.title: [paper] Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
item.description: Educational simulations are a well-established pedagogical technique that gives learners opportunities to apply knowledge, respond to challenges, and reflect on their performance.

item.title: [paper] ElasticDino: Dense Semantic Features Using Elastic Deformations
item.description: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts.

item.title: [paper] Compiling Known Rules into Compact Neural Agents: Weight-Space Programming on Unseen Games
item.description: Weight-space programming (WSP) uses language models to construct neural network weights without training. We test whether known game mechanics can be compiled into compact agents that generalise to held-out levels, renderings and start states within a game family.

item.title: [paper] Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
item.description: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech.

item.title: [paper] The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
item.description: Existing adaptive-reasoning methods shorten the explicit reasoning a model writes, or skip it by switching modes; either way the answer is still written out token by token.

item.title: [paper] Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off
item.description: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size.

item.title: [paper] A Disease-specific Retinal Aging Biomarker for Predicting Progression to Late Age-related Macular Degeneration
item.description: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss in older adults.

item.title: [paper] SignalAudit-QD: A Reproducible Audit Resource for External Signals in AI-Query Forecasting
item.description: SignalAudit-QD is a reproducible audit resource for testing whether a dated public signal adds information beyond query history in a fixed 20-term U.S. AI panel.

item.title: [paper] S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
item.description: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches.

item.title: [paper] Universal Infectious Disease Forecasting with Mantis 2
item.description: Public health agencies need to anticipate how outbreaks will unfold, when they will peak, and how long demand on health services will remain elevated.

item.title: [paper] Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
item.description: Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge.

item.title: [paper] Kezek: Splitting Mono Two-Person Conversations into Per-Speaker Tracks for Full-Duplex Dialogue Data
item.description: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models learn turn-taking, overlaps and backchannels from conversations recorded with one channel per speaker, but most available conversational audio is a single mono mix.

item.title: [paper] SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection
item.description: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task.

item.title: [paper] STEALTH: Steganographic Text Encoding Agnostic to Low-Level Tensor Hardware
item.description: Provably secure linguistic steganography hides a message inside text sampled from a language model, so that without the key, a stegotext is computationally indistinguishable from an honest model sample.

item.title: [paper] Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
item.description: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR
item.description: Speech recognition (ASR) systems are usually compared by word error rate (WER) on recorded files, after punctuation, capital letters and number format are removed.

item.title: [paper] CADET: Construction of PCB Routing Instances with Executable Demonstrations
item.description: Printed circuit board (PCB) routing is the stage of physical layout that finds paths connecting the placed pads of each net.

item.title: [paper] Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
item.description: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted.

item.title: [paper] Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
item.description: FOAM is a lightweight SOAP variant that uses input-only preconditioning and a factored Adam-moment estimator to match strong second-order and Muon baselines in LLM pre-training while using half the optimizer state and running at Muon-class speed.

item.title: [paper] Uncertainty-aware quantum machine learning based on Dempster-Shafer theory
item.description: A large body of work in quantum machine learning has centered on characterizing the expressivity and performance of quantum models. In contrast, little attention has been paid to the reliability of predictions beyond average performance measures such as accuracy.

item.title: [paper] TokenStream: Multi-Subject Personalized Video Generation with Token-wise LoRA and Guided Attention
item.description: We introduce TokenStream, an optimization-based framework that composes independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation without a reference-video training dataset or joint optimization of each new subject combination.

item.title: [paper] Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training
item.description: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

item.title: [paper] Look It Up: Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Codebook Search
item.description: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably.

item.title: [paper] LLM-Assisted Verification in Dafny
item.description: Formal verification of complex algorithms requires expertise in program specification, invariant construction, mathematical proof, and the management of automated theorem provers.

item.title: [paper] Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
item.description: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types.

item.title: [paper] Protein Language Models Fail To Capture Contact Predictions Under Invariant Relabeling
item.description: Protein language models (pLMs) produce highly accurate contact maps from single-sequence inputs.

item.title: [paper] Context Graph: Explainable Multi-Agent Decision Chains in AI-RAN
item.description: AI-RAN distributes network control across multiple autonomous agents, namely xApps and rApps operating over shared radio resources.

item.title: [paper] Stochastic Kernel Mode Decomposition: Information, Uncertainty, and Conditional Regime Inference
item.description: When do mode energies preserve regime information as measurement quality changes? Stochastic Kernel Mode Decomposition (sKMD) fits joint regime laws on signed KMD mode coordinates and transfers the reference mode posterior to regime probabilities and conditional reconstructions.

item.title: [paper] DPA: Decentralized Primal Averaging with Quasi-Global Momentum for Highly Heterogeneous Data
item.description: Decentralized training of deep learning models keeps training data local and supports on-device learning over networks.

item.title: [paper] Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
item.description: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes.
